name: Verity Sandbox Toolkit
description: Shared Verity agent-container tooling: gh + doppler + gitleaks + claude-code + codex + opencode + pi CLIs, npm supply-chain hardening, git SSH-signing config, the pre-commit/pre-push secret + code review gates, tmux, and the worktree helper. Single source of truth baked into verity-sandbox and injectable into any user devcontainer via --additional-features.

tz.description: IANA timezone for the container (sets TZ).

installClaude.description: Install the @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI globally (requires node on PATH).

installCodex.description: Install the @openai/codex CLI globally (requires node on PATH).

installOpencode.description: Install the opencode-ai CLI globally (requires node on PATH).

opencodeVersion.description: Exact opencode-ai npm version to pin.

installPi.description: Install the @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent CLI globally (requires node on PATH).

installRunnerSupervisor.description: Reserve the dedicated UID/GID and install the ADR 0006 Runner supervisor. Verity enables this for its managed default sandbox and for project devcontainer builds alike; a project devcontainer must additionally pass the provisioner's D1 boundary attestation before the supervisor is started.

runnerUid.description: Numeric UID reserved for the sandbox-local Verity Runner supervisor.

runtimeGid.description: Numeric GID shared only by the Runner runtime owner and Verity server.

ghVersion.description: Exact cli/cli (GitHub CLI) release version to pin (no leading v).

dopplerVersion.description: Exact DopplerHQ/cli release version to pin.

gitleaksVersion.description: Exact gitleaks/gitleaks release version to pin (no leading v). Backs the agent-seed pre-commit/pre-push secret gate.

ghTokenFile.description: Runtime bind path of the GitHub App installation token file (provisioner-supplied; not created at install time).

sshSigningKey.description: Runtime bind path of the public SSH signing key (git user.signingkey).

sshSigningKeyPrivate.description: Runtime bind path of the private SSH signing/auth key (ssh IdentityFile).

claudeConfigDir.description: Runtime persistent Claude config dir (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR); provisioner binds a writable volume here.

hooksPath.description: git core.hooksPath — points at the agent-seed pre-commit secret hook and the pre-push secret + code review hook.
